decision: PARTIAL -> W1: author the page's figure. ncsu_ext (Brassica rapa Chinensis Group, the species-scoped page) states "Bury seeds 1/4 to 1/2 in deep and space or thin plants to 6 in apart." -> in_row [6,6]; no row figure (not_authored). Today's [6,12] joins this 6 with UMN's joint Chinese-cabbage-and-bok-choy page ('thin to one plant every 12 to 18 inches', full-size heads), a two-page blend (W6) and the UMN figure never reaches 12 as a low. The species page wins on scope; UMN [12,18] is the alternative for a full-size-head regime. bok-choy leaves the R5 hunt list (W5): a cited page states a figure. Prose that gives 6 in for baby plants and 12-18 for full-size heads states the entry's figure and a second page-backed regime: agrees.
